chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:
"Strike your servant for disobedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and pardon him regarding what comes to you [as a personal offense]."

key_terms.إِلَيْكَ: to you or against you personally

ai.seo_question: When should a person discipline a servant and when should they forgive?
ai.summary: This hadith distinguishes between wrongdoing related to disobedience toward Allah and personal wrongs done against oneself. It teaches discipline in matters of divine disobedience while encouraging pardon in matters of personal offense.
